title: Button progress
description: A button that shows the progress of a download or upload. The icon loops while the file transfers, then a receipt confirms it’s done.
iconsNote: The download and upload animations are one of a kind, so you won’t find other icons that behave the same way (but you can request one).

fragments.title: Define the element
fragments.note: Built-in triggers only. What each icon follows is written in its markup.

fragments.title: The button
fragments.note: Two attributes tell the icon, the fill and the label what is happening.

fragments.title: Set progress and stage
fragments.note: Two attributes. Everything on screen reads them.

fragments.title: One press, one cycle
fragments.note: The pretend transfer. A real one would call report() from onprogress.

fragments.title: Slide the label strip
fragments.note: Always upwards. Wrapping uses a copy of the first label past the end.

fragments.title: The progress bar
fragments.note: Scaled, not widened. The transition smooths the steps; done fades it out.

fragments.title: The receipt opening and leaving
fragments.note: The receipt slides out of the button, then fades away.
